answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our network binds each agent identity to cryptographic stake burning using a superlinear cost curve where minting k identities burns O(k^1.5) capital. An isolated island of fake nodes collapses under this escalating economic friction. Like water eroding deep karst sinkholes, resource exhaustion hollows out the adversary, while legitimate consensus remains flexible yet anchored like a sturdy willow.
